findings.cause: The clicked topic owner occupied camera slot a instead of the protagonist. Original game.exe retains the protagonist in slot a, the first other #show actor in b and the last distinct other in c.
findings.change: Resolve native actor slots independently of the clicked topic owner and #show Hero order; use the initiating protagonist in co-op. Existing authored camera directives remain intact.
authored_examples: Tr49_1 (Hero, Vor, Shopper despite clicking Shopper)

findings.cause: The imported/ahead-player quest guard rejected aligned objective updates after their parent quest had reached completed state. That cleared checkpoint eligibility and stopped location/day return while personal progression still returned.
findings.original_script: maps/zone10.mob completes q.gz10g.q36ag before later GSSetVarMax writes to objectives .11 and .12.
findings.change: For a present, clean, in-sync guest whose old value matches exactly, credit the authored transition, including cleanup/reset. Keep the divergent/absent guest guards.

findings.cause: client_hello includes mod_config, but the pristine-origin exact dictionary comparison did not include or remove this validated metadata, so current New hero packets could not receive the authored opening baseline.
findings.change: Require valid mod metadata, then remove that metadata from the strict new-character comparison. The RPC receiver continues to require the host content/progression signature.

findings.cause: A guest absent during host save load had its saved position replaced by a spawn near the leader.
findings.change: Remember absent saved players until the next travel. Restore only their freshly deployed units after a matching checkpoint handshake, without restoring already-present players again.

native_evidence.method: Static REA analysis plus authored briefing data; original executable was not driven interactively.
